refnamediv.refpurpose: Creates an instance from a Unix timestamp

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
public static staticDateTime::createFromTimestamp intfloattimestamp
Creates an instance from a Unix timestamp.
The timezone of the returned object is always the UTC offset +00:00, as with new DateTime('@' . $timestamp). The default timezone, as returned by date_default_timezone_get, is not used. To get the date and time in another timezone, call DateTime::setTimezone on the returned object.
